props.gloss_en: the mishna: fell into the fire and its innards were singed -- if green, unfit
R' Yehoshua ben Levi's hen: [its innards] were green, and R' Elazar HaKappar declared it kosher
they said 'green is unfit' only of the gizzard, the heart and the liver
the baraita: of which innards did they say it? of the gizzard, the heart and the liver
R' Yitzchak bar Yosef's hen: [its innards] were red, and [R' Abbahu ruled it] tereifa
and green [innards] that turned red -- tereifa
they said 'red is fit' only of the heart, the gizzard and the liver
R' Mani: red that turned green, and one boiled them and they turned red again -- fit
what is the reason? smoke entered them
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: we too shall say: red that did not turn green, and one boiled them and they turned green -- tereifa
what is the reason? their shame was revealed
Rav Ashi: therefore a person should eat [such a bird] only boiled
we do not presume a flaw
